subject: Fix genClusterDebugString minor sds leaks (#12739)
reason: The change only adds sdsfree calls in genClusterDebugString, which is reachable solely from printCrashReport via logServerInfo while the server is already crashing (assert, panic, or fatal signal handler). It fixes a tiny sds leak in a process moments from aborting; the crash-report output and all externally observable behaviour (replies, replication, persistence, topology) are identical on both builds. Exercising the code would require deliberately crashing a cluster-mode server, which the oracles treat as a failure and compared sequences forbid, so no scenario can meaningfully test it.
